title: AAPS continuously attempts to connect when disconnected from Dash Pods
symptom: After disconnecting from a Dash pod, AAPS continuously states it is trying to connect despite no new pod activation, draining battery at a high rate. This occurs on AAPS 3.4.0.0 and was observed on an AutoISF variant.
evidence_quote: After disconnecting from a Dash pod, AAPS will continuously state that it is trying to connect despite new Pod activation not being started.
